import sys, json, random, time
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/vendor'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tools')
from controller import run
from stress import wide_case
rng=random.Random(5)
def timed(name, cases):
    raw=json.dumps({'version':3,'cases':cases}).encode()
    t0=time.time(); out=run(raw); dt=time.time()-t0
    print('%-28s %.2fs  input=%dKB' % (name, dt, len(raw)//1024), [r['ratio'] for r in out['results']])
    sys.stdout.flush()
timed('512win 1 slot', [wide_case(rng,512,1,32,4)])
timed('512win 4 slots', [wide_case(rng,512,4,32,4)])
timed('512win 256 narrow', [wide_case(rng,512,256,32,4,tmax=1000)])
timed('2x512 one flow', [wide_case(rng,512,256,1,0) for _ in range(2)])
timed('1x512 32 flows t64', [wide_case(rng,512,256,32,0)])
timed('2x512 32f 32g tight', [wide_case(rng,512,256,32,32) for _ in range(2)])
